payload.summary: Orphaned owner-catalogue-cache is still invalidated by the seed writers
payload.detail: `src/lib/owner-catalogue-cache.ts` lost its only search-path reader on 2026-09-09 (b753ed2b1), which is the commit that caused the seven-day registry-search outage. The module is still in the tree and `invalidateOwnerCatalogueCache` is still called by `src/lib/registry-seed.ts` and `src/lib/medication-seed.ts` after a write. Those calls now clear a cache nothing reads, so anyone checking whether the catalogue cache is invalidated on publish gets a misleading yes. Two things to settle together: retire the dead module through the dead-code-deletion protocol, and decide whether the cache that replaced it (`src/lib/site-content/site-content-record-cache.ts`, 15 s fresh / 10 min stale-while-revalidate) needs an invalidation hook on publish or whether the TTL is the intended contract. Context: docs/audit/2026-09-16-registry-search-outage.md.
